pregunta: El ingreso total de un evento es la suma de sus entradas pagadas más los aportes de sus patrocinadores. Muestra el título y el ingreso total de los 3 eventos con mayor ingreso, ordenados de mayor a menor.
sql_referencia: WITH ventas AS (SELECT evt_id, SUM(price_paid) AS total_entradas FROM ticket WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY evt_id), patrocinio AS (SELECT evt_id, SUM(amount) AS total_patrocinio FROM evt_sponsor GROUP BY evt_id) SELECT e.title, ROUND(COALESCE(v.total_entradas, 0) + COALESCE(p.total_patrocinio, 0), 2) AS ingreso_total FROM evt e LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.evt_id = e.evt_id LEFT JOIN patrocinio p ON p.evt_id = e.evt_id ORDER BY ingreso_total DESC LIMIT 3
sql_generada: WITH pg AS (SELECT evt_id, SUM(price_paid) AS ingresos FROM ticket WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY evt_id) SELECT e.title, COALESCE(p.ingresos, 0) + COALESCE(pg.ingresos, 0) AS ingreso_total FROM evt e LEFT JOIN evt_sponsor ps ON ps.evt_id = e.evt_id LEFT JOIN sponsor s ON s.sponsor_id = ps.sponsor_id LEFT JOIN pg ON pg.evt_id = e.evt_id WHERE s.sponsor_name IN (SELECT sponsor_name FROM sponsor) ORDER BY ingreso_total DESC LIMIT 3

pregunta: Muestra el nombre, el apellido y el costo promedio de mano de obra por orden (redondeado a 2 decimales) de los mecánicos cuyo promedio en órdenes entregadas supera 100.

pregunta: Calcula el gasto total de cada cliente en órdenes entregadas, sumando la mano de obra y los repuestos (cantidad por precio unitario cobrado). Muestra el nombre, el apellido y el gasto total de los 5 clientes que más han gastado, ordenados de mayor a menor gasto.
sql_referencia: WITH rep_ord AS (SELECT id_ord, SUM(cant * p_unit) AS total_rep FROM det_ord GROUP BY id_ord), gasto AS (SELECT v.id_cli, SUM(o.costo_mo + COALESCE(r.total_rep, 0)) AS total FROM ord_srv o JOIN veh v ON v.id_veh = o.id_veh LEFT JOIN rep_ord r ON r.id_ord = o.id_ord WHERE o.est = 'Entregada' GROUP BY v.id_cli) SELECT c.nom, c.ape, ROUND(g.total, 2) AS gasto_total FROM gasto g JOIN cli c ON c.id_cli = g.id_cli ORDER BY g.total DESC LIMIT 5
sql_generada: WITH t AS (SELECT id_cli, SUM(costo_mo + SUM(CASE WHEN est = 'En proceso' THEN cant * p_unit ELSE 0 END)) AS gasto FROM ord_srv WHERE f_ent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id_cli) SELECT c.nom, c.ape, t.gasto FROM t JOIN cli c ON t.id_cli = c.id_cli ORDER BY t.gasto DESC LIMIT 5

sql_generada: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f_ing, '%Y-%m') AS mes, COUNT(*) AS num_ordenes, SUM(costo_mo) AS total_mes, SUM(SUM(costo_mo)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(f_ing, '%Y-%m')) AS total_acumulado FROM ord_srv WHERE YEAR(f_ing) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(f_ing, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mes

pregunta: ¿Qué órdenes entregadas tardaron más días en entregarse que el promedio de días de todas las órdenes entregadas? Muestra el número de orden, la placa y los días transcurridos entre el ingreso y la entrega, ordenados de más a menos días y, en caso de empate, por número de orden.
sql_referencia: SELECT o.id_ord, v.placa, DATEDIFF(o.f_ent, o.f_ing) AS dias FROM ord_srv o JOIN veh v ON v.id_veh = o.id_veh WHERE o.f_ent IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(o.f_ent, o.f_ing) > (SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(f_ent, f_ing)) FROM ord_srv WHERE f_ent IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY dias DESC, o.id_ord

sql_generada: WITH t AS (SELECT c.ciu, c.nom, c.ape, COUNT(*) AS num_ordenes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.ciu ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rk FROM ord_srv o JOIN veh v ON v.id_veh = o.id_veh JOIN cli c ON c.id_cli = v.id_cli GROUP BY c.ciu, c.id_cli, c.nom, c.ape) SELECT ciu, nom, ape, num_ordenes FROM t WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY ciu
